description: This file defines a catalog of books for a bookstore frontend, including functions to normalize book data, generate prices deterministically, and retrieve books by category. It exports book lists for trending, global bestsellers, and Indian bestsellers, along with genre configurations and utility functions.

methods.name: priceFromSeed
methods.description: Generates a deterministic price from a string seed based on a hash function.

methods.name: normalizeBook
methods.description: Normalizes a book object to ensure required fields and a valid price.

methods.name: getAllBooks
methods.description: Combines and deduplicates all book lists into a full catalog.

methods.name: getBooksForCategory
methods.description: Returns books filtered by specified category or genre.
